programmes.name: Applied Data Science
programmes.description: Use statistics, computing and a chosen science discipline to investigate real data.
programmes.curriculum: Data challenges, mathematical and IT techniques, applied science studies and electives.
programmes.practical: Third-year project-based unit involves industry; studio case studies throughout the course.

programmes.name: Data Science major in the Bachelor of Science
programmes.qualification: Bachelor of Science, Data Science major
programmes.credits: 300 Melbourne points for BSc; major is 100 points within it
programmes.description: Study statistical and computational methods for analysing large datasets.
programmes.curriculum: Eight major subjects in years two and three, including a capstone; the rest is BSc core, electives and breadth.
programmes.practical: 12.5-point capstone; an internship is not guaranteed.

programmes.name: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.qualification: Bachelor of Computing (Hons); selected-intake title needs confirmation
programmes.description: Combine statistics, computing and artificial intelligence to understand data and build models.
programmes.curriculum: Data preparation, modelling and visualisation, AI, analytics, electives and responsible technology.
programmes.practical: Projects, capstone work and industry immersion are documented.

programmes.name: Data Analytics major in the Bachelor of Science
programmes.qualification: Bachelor of Science, Data Analytics major
programmes.description: Combine computing and statistics to extract useful information and reason about uncertainty.
programmes.curriculum: 2027 major combines introductory computing, statistics, data analysis and advanced data analysis.
programmes.practical: Computing laboratories; research and work-integrated options depend on the chosen papers.

programmes.name: Digital Media and Communication
programmes.qualification: Bachelor of Digital Media and Communication
programmes.description: Explore how digital platforms, media content and communication affect society.
programmes.curriculum: Digital media studies, communication foundations, professional practice and electives.
programmes.practical: Digital research project or internship application; confirm placement arrangements.

programmes.name: Food Science and Technology
programmes.qualification: Bachelor of Food Science and Technology
programmes.description: Investigate how to turn raw ingredients into safe, nutritious food.
programmes.curriculum: Chemistry, microbiology, food processing, preservation, packaging and quality management.
programmes.practical: Required eight-week internship plus laboratory and pilot food-processing work.

programmes.name: International Communications Studies
programmes.duration: 4 years with preliminary year; 3-year entry depends on qualifications
programmes.description: Study media, communication and cultural change across international settings.
programmes.curriculum: Communication and media theory, research skills and cultural analysis; confirm selected-cycle modules.
programmes.practical: Practical project and internship requirements need programme-specific confirmation.

programmes.name: Primary Teaching
programmes.description: Learn how primary-age children learn and how to plan and assess classroom teaching.
programmes.curriculum: Primary education studies with curriculum teaching, reflective practice and school experience.
programmes.practical: School experience starts in year one; graduation supports an application for provisional teacher registration.
programmes.campus: Hamilton or Tauranga; confirm international on-campus availability

routes.name: Kazakhstan certificate plus AP or UK A levels
routes.eligibility: Ordinary Kazakhstan High School Certificate requires additional qualifications: at least three AP tests with grades 4 and 5, or at least three UK A levels with good passes. Minimums do not guarantee admission.
routes.recognition: The ordinary certificate alone is insufficient. AP/A-level preparation may add time and costs; amounts are not verified. NIS Grade 12 has a separate route and is not ordinary Grade 11.
routes.subjects: Choose AP or A-level subjects against the programme prerequisites; verify the precise Mathematics and AP Calculus BC requirements before booking tests.

ENGLISH.detail: English test evidence is required when school instruction is not English, or English is ESL/EAL. An eligible English-medium qualification can satisfy the conditional exemption.

IELTS.detail: English option: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with 6.5 in Writing and Speaking.

SAT.detail: English-evidence option only: 1250 total and 600 Reading and Writing. SAT does not replace the required AP/A-level academic qualification.

AP.detail: At least three AP tests with grades 4 and 5; subjects must meet programme prerequisites.
